title: FrontRow: paste the Supabase service key into Netlify
_note: Step 2 of 3 for the FrontRow token 503 (2026-11-07). Run after supabase.com/guides/rotate-frontrow-service-key.guide.json put the key on Mike's clipboard. Prefill only opens SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and its Edit form (each variable is li > details > summary; Edit is the first button.menuitem in the Options menu of the open details). Mike pastes and saves; Yeshie never reads or types the value. The field steps finish when Mike clicks into the field, because a hidden secret field has no reliable sign that a paste happened; the Save step is confirmed by the edit form closing. Other contexts and other variables are left alone. The tab stays open for redeploy-frontrowtheater.guide.json (run it with --tab).

steps.instruction: Click into the Production value, press Cmd+A to select the old key, then Cmd+V to paste the key you copied from Supabase.
Do the same in Deploy Previews: click into it, Cmd+A, then Cmd+V. Leave the other contexts as they are.
